queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   CreationTime Workload (ClientIP or ClientIPAddress) 
| json "Workload"
| json "ClientIP" as src_ip_1 nodrop // for non-Exchange
| json "ClientIPAddress" as src_ip_2 nodrop //  for Exchange
| if (workload="Exchange", src_ip_2, src_ip_1) as src_ip
|where if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{workload}}" = "*", true, workload matches "{{workload}}")
| count by src_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code from geo://location on ip = src_ip
| where !isNull(latitude)

panels.title: SP and  OD Transactions by Client Location

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   CreationTime "ClientIP" ( "\"Workload\":\"SharePoint\"" or  "\"Workload\":\"OneDrive\"" ) 
| json "Workload", "Operation"
| json "ClientIP" as src_ip
| where workload in ("SharePoint","OneDrive")
|where if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{workload}}" = "*", true, workload matches "{{workload}}")
|count by src_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code from geo://location on ip = src_ip
| where !isNull(latitude)

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   CreationTime ClientIPAddress "\"Workload\":\"Exchange\""
| parse "\"Workload\":\"*\"" as Workload
| parse "\"ClientIPAddress\":\"*\"" as src_ip 
| where Workload = "Exchange" and !isBlank(src_ip)
|where if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{workload}}" = "*", true, workload matches "{{workload}}")
| count by src_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code from geo://location on ip = src_ip
| where !isNull(latitude)

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   CreationTime "\"Workload\":\"AzureActiveDirectory\"" "ClientIP"
| json "Workload"
| json "ClientIP" as src_ip 
| where Workload = "AzureActiveDirectory"
|where if ("{{src_ip}}" = "*", true, src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}") AND if ("{{workload}}" = "*", true, workload matches "{{workload}}")
|count by src_ip 
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code from geo://location on ip = src_ip
| where !isNull(latitude)
